instruction: Follow Vue 3 Composition API best practices with correct reactivity patterns, composable structure, Pinia setup stores, and accessibility
relevant_when: Agent builds or reviews Vue 3 components, composables, or Pinia stores
context: Vue 3 components should use <script setup lang='ts'> with typed props/emits, composables should follow the useThing pattern with onMounted and try/catch/finally, Pinia stores should use setup syntax with computed for derived values and watch for side effects, and all interactive elements must be accessible.

checklist.name: script-setup-typescript
checklist.rule: Agent uses <script setup lang='ts'> on every .vue component file
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates or modifies Vue single-file components

checklist.name: typed-props
checklist.rule: Agent types props with defineProps<T>() using a TypeScript interface, not runtime defineProps({ prop: String }) syntax
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates Vue components that accept props

checklist.name: typed-emits
checklist.rule: Agent types emits with defineEmits<{ event: [payloadType] }>() using object-and-tuple generic syntax
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates Vue components that emit events

checklist.name: composable-structure
checklist.rule: Agent places composables in composables/ directory, names them useThing, returns refs and a reload/retry function
checklist.relevant_when: Agent extracts reusable logic into composable functions

checklist.name: composable-onMounted
checklist.rule: Agent uses onMounted() inside composables to trigger initial data fetching, not a bare function call at setup time
checklist.relevant_when: Agent writes composables that fetch data

checklist.name: composable-error-handling
checklist.rule: Agent clears error ref before each fetch attempt (error.value = null before try) and sets loading false in finally block
checklist.relevant_when: Agent writes async composables with loading/error state

checklist.name: template-state-chain
checklist.rule: Agent handles loading/error/success states with v-if/v-else-if/v-else chain in templates
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates components that display async data

checklist.name: ref-for-primitives
checklist.rule: Agent uses ref() for primitive values and arrays, never destructures reactive() without toRefs()
checklist.relevant_when: Agent declares reactive state in components or composables

checklist.name: no-reactive-reassignment
checklist.rule: Agent never reassigns reactive objects directly; uses Object.assign() or property mutation instead
checklist.relevant_when: Agent resets or bulk-updates reactive object state

checklist.name: pinia-setup-store
checklist.rule: Agent uses Pinia Setup Store pattern: defineStore('name', () => { ... return { ... } }) not Options Store syntax

checklist.name: computed-for-derived
checklist.rule: Agent uses computed() for derived values inside Pinia stores and components
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates values derived from reactive state

checklist.name: watch-for-side-effects
checklist.rule: Agent uses watch() for side effects (redirects, toasts, localStorage) triggered by state changes, not embedded in action functions
checklist.relevant_when: Agent implements reactive side effects in stores or components

checklist.name: storeToRefs-destructuring
checklist.rule: Agent uses storeToRefs() when destructuring state/getters from Pinia stores; actions are destructured directly
checklist.relevant_when: Agent accesses Pinia store state in components

checklist.name: store-folder-placement
checklist.rule: Agent places Pinia store files in a stores/ directory

checklist.name: local-vs-shared-state
checklist.rule: Agent uses Pinia for cross-component state and local ref() for component-only state (form fields, toggles)
checklist.relevant_when: Agent decides where to place state

checklist.name: aria-label-buttons
checklist.rule: Agent adds :aria-label with descriptive text on all interactive elements (buttons, links), including retry buttons in error states
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates interactive elements in Vue templates

checklist.name: role-alert-errors
checklist.rule: Agent adds role='alert' on error display containers for screen reader accessibility
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates error display regions in Vue templates
